primaryWitnesses.text: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.

negativeWikiSearch.reviewedLocator: Gur disambiguation, lines 116-159; the Places list contains Gur, Tibet; Gur, Iran; Gur-e Sefid; Gur (river), but not the ascent of 2 Kings 9:27. The page identifies itself as a disambiguation at lines 158-159.
negativeWikiSearch.noteJa: 「Gur」記事はチベットやイランの同名地などを並べる曖昧さ回避ページで、列王記下9:27のイブルアム近くの坂を説明する記事ではありません。適合する記事本文を確認できなかったためリンクを付けていません。
